div.head: V Atr Prol.
div.ab: Ðis is seo gerædnes, þe Engla cyng ⁊ ægðer ge gehadode ge læwede witan gecuran and geræddan.
Ðis is seo gerædnes, þe Engla cyng ⁊ ægþer ge gehadode ge læwede witan gecuran and geræddan.
Ðis is seo gerædnes, þe Engla cyningc [⁊] ægðer [ge] gehadode ge læwede witan gecuron ⁊ geræddon.
This is the ordinance which has been determined upon and enacted by the king of England and his councillors, both ecclesiastic and lay.
Prolog. Dies ist die Satzung, die der König der Engländer und sowohl geweihte wie Laien-Witan erkoren und bestimmt haben.
Prologue. This is the ordinance which the king of the English and both the ecclesiastical and lay witan have chosen and decided.
div.note: ‘Æþelred’ is missing after ‘þe’, already in the archetype, but hardly in the original prologue, which perhaps also named the place, Enham (Liebermann, after X Atr Prol. 3). Liebermann compares EGu Prol.
